name: Ali I of Yejju
role: Ras of Begdemer in the Ethiopian Empire
contribution: Ras of Begemder, and following the death of Ras Mikael Sehul, Regent of the Emperor of Ethiopia.

checks.lead: Ali I of Yejju (died 18 June 1788) was Ras of Begemder, and following the death of Ras Mikael Sehul, Regent of the Emperor of Ethiopia. He was the son of Abba Seru Gwangul, chieftain of the Yejju, and Woizero Gelebu Faris, daughter of Ras Faris of Tigray.
